_comment: Calibration of read_scale.py for the 2026-11-02 evening camera framing (digits lower and further left than in scale_calib_2026-11-02.json; only the search region differs). Lengths in pixels of a 640x480 frame at scale 1.
_geometry_notes: Lengths are pixels at scale 1. Cell coordinates: u right, v down, origin = digit-cell centre. Four cells (tens, ones, tenths, hundredths); cell pitch, slant (italic), tilt (camera roll, px per cell) are refined per frame from the 'starts'. 長さは拡大率 1 の画素。セルのピッチ・傾き・カメラの回転は 'starts' を初期値に 1 枚ごとに追い込む。
_seg_gain_notes: Median darkness of a lit segment a..g relative to the 99.5 percentile ink level, measured on about 500 frames; levels are divided by it. 点灯セグメント a..g の標準的な濃さ（約 500 枚で実測）。濃度をこれで割る。
_threshold_notes: on_min: lit segment must reach this (gain-normalised); off_max: unlit segment must stay below; dp_on: decimal point; stray_max/faint_max: share of ink (>stray_ink / >faint_ink) outside the predicted segments; cost_max: fit misfit. 判定しきい値。

minus._notes: Boxes [x0, x1, y0, y1] in frame pixels for this framing. Measured darkness: 89-93 with the sign, 8-10 without. / この画角での範囲。
